record.label: Clean-ancilla time evolution for one femtosecond
record.statement: A candidate circuit must realize a single unitary $W$ whose action on every system state with zero ancillas is within $\varepsilon=10^{-2}$ of $e^{-iHt}$ with zero ancillas, for $t=1$ fs and up to a global phase.
record.boundary: Lean sets the system projector to the identity, so the bound applies to every system state, including states outside the antisymmetric and low-energy subspaces. The norm includes the output component orthogonal to the zero-ancilla subspace.
